certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Trigonometry Essentials (Ages 14-17)

learning_outcomes.text: Use the Pythagorean theorem in right-angled triangles
Define sine, cosine and tangent as ratios
Find missing sides in right-angled triangles using trigonometry
Find missing angles using inverse trigonometric functions
Apply trigonometry to angles of elevation and depression
Solve practical problems involving right-angled triangles

integrative_case: Work out the height of the school flagpole without climbing it: measure a distance along the ground and the angle of elevation to the top, then use tangent to calculate the height and check it with the Pythagorean theorem.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
